meta.description: Assignment of cause/effect (eitza) nodes from Torah #25 to existing bechina-based packages

assignments.reason: Tzedaka (charity) is the act of giving silver and gold (כסף וזהב) to a worthy Jew. In Torah #25, the entire discussion of charity revolves around the revelation of the supernal colors (גונין עלאין) that dwell within money. The essential nature of צדקה in this Torah is the mechanism by which money returns to its holy domain and the colors shine — it IS the silver-and-gold domain in its active, practical dimension.

The revelation of the Creator's greatness is explicitly defined in the Torah as the revelation of the supernal colors: 'עיקר הגדולה והפאר הוא התגלות הגונין.' This is the same essential nature as גדלות הבורא (already in Package 5 via additions) — it is the manifested/revealed form of the Divine glory through the colors.

The node itself is named 'the aforementioned colors, which are the Creator's greatness' — explicitly identifying the supernal colors with Divine greatness. Its essential nature is the colors/glory domain of Package 5.

The state of 'the colors being revealed and shining' is the activated/manifest form of the supernal colors (גונין עלאין). Its essential nature is the Divine beauty/glory domain — the same colors that are the essence of Package 5, now in their revealed state.

The rectification of all one's money is the state of money (כסף וזהב) being restored to its holy purpose, enabling the supernal colors to shine. The text places this as the direct context: 'נתתקן כל ממונו, ונתגלין הגונין ומאירין.' Its essential nature is the silver-and-gold domain in its rectified state.

assignments.node_id: נעשה כל ממונו בבחינת: לי הכסף ולי הזהב
assignments.node_text: וְנַעֲשֶׂה כָּל מָמוֹנוֹ בִּבְחִינַת: 'לִי הַכֶּסֶף וְלִי הַזָּהָב'
assignments.reason: This node describes money becoming sanctified as 'Mine is the silver, mine is the gold' — the Divine claim on the precious metals. It explicitly invokes כסף וזהב (the core of Package 5) and represents the culmination of the colors/money domain when money is in its holy state.

assignments.node_id: אפשר להכניע הקלפות, הינו הדמיונות והמחשבות והתאוות והבלבולים והמניעות שבמדרגה
assignments.node_text: אֶפְשָׁר לְהַכְנִיעַ הַקְּלִפּוֹת, הַיְנוּ הַדִּמְיוֹנוֹת וְהַמַּחֲשָׁבוֹת וְהַתַּאֲווֹת וְהַבִּלְבּוּלִים וְהַמְּנִיעוֹת שֶׁבַּמַּדְרֵגָה
assignments.reason: Although this node names the klipot (imaginations, desires, confusions), its essential nature is the ACT OF SUBDUING them — 'אפשר להכניע.' This places it in the good domain of liberation from imagination, the same essential nature as the shamir (שמיר) that breaks the stone heart. It is the positive capacity to overcome evil, not the evil itself.

assignments.node_id: סתירת הפתח, שהוא המדמה, שהוא הטמאה
assignments.node_text: סְתִירַת הַפֶּתַח, שֶׁהוּא הַמְדַמֶּה, שֶׁהוּא הַטֻּמְאָה
assignments.reason: The text explicitly identifies this as 'the opening, which is the imagination, which is impurity' (הַמְדַמֶּה, שֶׁהוּא הַטֻּמְאָה). While the word 'סתירה' (tearing down) sounds active/good, the node names the OBJECT being torn down: the evil opening/gate of impurity. Its essential nature is the imagination-faculty/impurity domain — the evil force blocking entry to holiness. The text links it to 'לפתח חטאת רובץ' and 'הבא לטמא פותחין לו.'

Breaking the klipa and entering the next level is the direct expression of the shamir's function — the act of breaking through the shell of imagination to reach holiness. Its essential nature is identical to Package 2's core: שמיר / כשיוצא משרירות הלב ומשבר לבו האבן. This is the good act of spiritual breakthrough.

assignments.node_id: שיעורר שמחה של מצוה על עצמו. הינו שישמח על־ידי שיזכר שזכה להתקרב להשם יתברך, וזכה להתקרב לצדיקים המקרבין אותו להשם יתברך
assignments.node_text: שֶׁיְּעוֹרֵר שִׂמְחָה שֶׁל מִצְוָה עַל עַצְמוֹ. הַיְנוּ שֶׁיִּשְׂמַח עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁיִּזְכֹּר שֶׁזָּכָה לְהִתְקָרֵב לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ, וְזָכָה לְהִתְקָרֵב לַצַּדִּיקִים הַמְקָרְבִין אוֹתוֹ לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
assignments.reason: Arousing joy of mitzvah — remembering one's closeness to Hashem and to the tzaddikim — is the emotional/spiritual instrument that breaks the klipa at each level. Section ה of the Torah introduces this as the method for subduing the klipa: 'על־זה צריך שיעורר שמחה של מצוה על עצמו... ועל־ידי השמחה זו הוא משבר הקלפה.' Its essential nature is the good force of spiritual liberation — the same domain as the shamir (Package 2), which is the capacity to break through the shell of imagination. Joy of mitzvah is to the emotional realm what the shamir is to the stone heart.
